chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: An old trombone ballad record and the circus-instrument myth
summary: They listen to a c. 1910 record with a remarkable trombone ballad solo, and Morgenstern says it is wrong that the trombone was a circus instrument before jazz players got hold of it.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
